title: ConvSim NPC
description: Validates an NPC definition file. All NPCs must be fictional.

archetype.description: Behaviour archetype slug used for system prompt construction.

fictional.description: Must be true. Real-person impersonation is not permitted in MVP.

age_band.description: Only 'adult' NPCs are permitted in MVP.

licensed_persona.$comment: Reserved for a future licensed persona namespace. Not implemented in schema v0.1. This field is explicitly blocked to prevent incompatible use before the namespace is defined.

portrait.description: Relative path to portrait image within the pack.

attack_surface.description: The roastable topology of this character: what about them is fair game. Read by flyting scenarios (scenario mode: flyting) — the per-volley judge may only claim a hook whose id appears here, and the engine drops any claim whose quoted evidence is not actually present in the player's volley. Ignored by conversation-mode scenarios.

id.description: Stable trait id, unique within this NPC. Referenced by judge hooks and calibration fixtures.

brief.description: One or two sentences a player (or the judge) can aim at.

visibility.description: visible = in the player brief from the start. discoverable = revealed when first struck, and worth double on discovery.

themes.description: Theme slugs this trait belongs to, used by the judge's theme-decay accounting.

boundaries.description: Hard rules the NPC must never violate.
